proposed_widenings.name: resource-less non-spell triggered_reaction mechanics
proposed_widenings.justification: The existing magic-item triggered_reaction family requires an ActivationResource and RestResetCadence, but Gloves of Missile Snaring has no per-rest or charge pool. It only spends the normal reaction quota when the trigger occurs.
proposed_widenings.evidence: If you're hit by an attack roll made with a Ranged or Thrown weapon while wearing these gloves, you can take a Reaction to reduce the damage...

proposed_widenings.name: EquipmentPredicate.free_hand_available
proposed_widenings.justification: The damage-reduction rider is additionally gated by hand state. Current equipment predicates can express wearing/holding/wielding, but not "you have a free hand."

notes: Did not author content JSON/Dhall. The core reaction shape almost fits, but the current surface cannot encode an unlimited-use non-spell reaction honestly. The secondary catch-the-projectile rider is also not representable in the current surface and is described in the proposal.
